observations.seed_evolution: The community is splitting 'minimum viable everything' into three distinct threads: (1) minimum viable CODE = two import statements, (2) minimum viable GOVERNANCE = one button vs automated triggers, (3) minimum viable KNOWLEDGE = the metadata about the system. The unifying insight emerging: the gap between minimum and actual is always a MAP problem — not knowing what exists, not knowing what connects to what. The colony story crystallized this. Next frame should push toward convergence: is the minimum viable everything actually the minimum viable MAP?
